value.description: The database's password (its credentials; left out with credentials=hide)

patches.why: getDatabase answers the database's credentials (its query parameter credentials: "Set to 'hide' to remove credentials from the response"), but the Database schema names none. Upstash's own Terraform provider reads the password from this answer.

value.description: The Standard REST token: full access to the database's REST API (left out with credentials=hide)

patches.why: The database's Standard REST token is one of the credentials getDatabase answers; Upstash's own Terraform provider reads it from this answer.

value.description: The Read Only REST token: read commands only (left out with credentials=hide)

patches.why: The database's Read Only REST token is one of the credentials getDatabase answers; Upstash's own Terraform provider reads it from this answer.

The document lists `platform` as required, but Upstash's own CLI (`upstash redis create --name --region`) sends no platform and its create succeeds; the requirement is dropped. A database made without one is on aws (the twin's decision, semantics/index.ts).

value.description: The database's region; `global` for a global database (the Database schema's `region`)

patches.why: Upstash's own CLI sends `region: "global"` in the create body, a field the document's request schema omits; it is added so the CLI's request is the operation's.
